<!--
What it does: An interactive page on the variable costs reported by the
  African studies in the 2022 World Bank NbS extraction, cleaned for CC4A:
  how many papers report variable costs for 1, 2, 3 ... years; a list of
  those papers to filter by years; and, for a paper picked from the list, its
  variable costs over the years with the cost items they include.
Reads: data/wb_nbs_extraction_2022_cc4a.xlsx  (sheet extracted_cc4a)
Writes: the rendered HTML, docs/reports/wb2022_explorer.html when built with
  R/00_prep/render_wb2022_explorer.R
Flags: none. Knit in RStudio, or run R/00_prep/render_wb2022_explorer.R.
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.5)
root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("CC4A.Rproj"))
source(file.path(root, "R/00_shared/paths.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(plotly)
  library(crosstalk)
  library(DT)
})

# The cost outcome this page is about. Other money outcomes (total cost,
# gross margin ...) can be swapped in here.
COST_OUTCOME <- "Variable Cost"

# Cost item columns in the extraction: yes/no flags for what a cost includes.
COST_ITEMS <- c("Seeds", "Nutrient Inputs", "Labour", "Pest Control Inputs", "Land (rent)",
                "Equipment Costs", "Tax", "Transport", "Irrigation")
# Short names for the same items, so the lists fit in a table cell.
COST_ITEM_SHORT <- c("seed", "fertiliser", "labour", "pest control", "land",
                     "equipment", "tax", "transport", "irrigation")

PRACTICE_LABELS <- c(
  awd = "AWD (irrigated rice)", biochar = "Biochar", ca_bundle = "Reduced tillage / CA",
  dsr = "Direct-seeded rice", feed_mgmt = "Feed management",
  nutrient_mgmt_b = "Nutrient management / ISFM", rotational_grazing = "Rotational grazing",
  silvopasture = "Silvopasture", soil_cover = "Soil cover", sri = "SRI",
  trees_in_farmlands = "Trees in farmlands"
)

COL_PRACTICE <- "#1f6fb4"
COL_CONTROL <- "#7f7f7f"
```

```{r data}
raw <- readxl::read_excel(FILE_WB2022_CC4A, sheet = "extracted_cc4a", col_types = "text")

#' TRUE where any country named in the cell is in Africa ("Bangladesh/India/
#' Nepal" names three). Looked up once per distinct cell.
is_africa <- function(country) {
  cells <- unique(ifelse(is.na(country), "", country))
  hit <- vapply(strsplit(cells, "[/;,]"), function(p) {
    cont <- suppressWarnings(countrycode::countrycode(trimws(p), "country.name", "continent"))
    any(cont %in% "Africa", na.rm = TRUE)
  }, TRUE)
  unname(setNames(hit, cells)[ifelse(is.na(country), "", country)])
}

#' Years a measurement covers. The column mixes formats: 2017; lists such as
#' 2017.2018; seasons such as 2018.1 or 2018.2.2019.2; ranges such as
#' 2009-2019; and Excel damage such as 2016.2017000000001 or 2009.201
#' (2009.2010 with its trailing zero dropped).
parse_years <- function(s) {
  s <- trimws(s)
  if (is.na(s) || !grepl("(19|20)[0-9]{2}", s)) return(integer())
  if (grepl("^[0-9]{4} *- *[0-9]{4}$", s)) {
    r <- as.integer(strsplit(s, " *- *")[[1]])
    return(seq(min(r), max(r)))
  }
  if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}[.][0-9]{9,}$", s)) {
    second <- round(as.numeric(paste0("0.", substring(s, 6))) * 1e4)
    return(unique(c(as.integer(substr(s, 1, 4)), as.integer(second))))
  }
  if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}[.][0-9]{3}$", s)) {
    return(unique(c(as.integer(substr(s, 1, 4)), as.integer(paste0(substring(s, 6), "0")))))
  }
  tok <- strsplit(s, "[.;,/ ]+")[[1]]
  unique(as.integer(tok[grepl("^(19|20)[0-9]{2}$", tok)]))
}

#' Position on the time axis: the year, moved a third of a year per season
#' where a season is given (2013.2 sits at 2013.33).
time_point <- function(raw_year, year) {
  season <- ifelse(grepl("^[0-9]{4}[.][1-3]$", trimws(raw_year)),
                   as.integer(substring(trimws(raw_year), 6)), 1L)
  year + (season - 1) / 3
}

#' Short text saying which cost items a cost includes, for example
#' "Seeds, Labour; not Land (rent)". `d` holds the COST_ITEMS columns of one
#' or more rows; an item counts as included when any row says yes.
items_text <- function(d) {
  v <- as.matrix(d[, COST_ITEMS])
  yes <- COST_ITEMS[apply(v, 2, function(x) any(grepl("^\\(?yes", x, ignore.case = TRUE)))]
  no <- setdiff(COST_ITEMS[apply(v, 2, function(x) any(grepl("^no", x, ignore.case = TRUE)))], yes)
  short <- setNames(COST_ITEM_SHORT, COST_ITEMS)
  out <- c(if (length(yes)) paste(short[yes], collapse = ", "),
           if (length(no)) paste("not", paste(short[no], collapse = ", ")))
  if (length(out)) paste(out, collapse = "; ") else "not recorded"
}
items_by_row <- function(d) {
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) items_text(d[i, , drop = FALSE]), "")
}

# Africa only, from the start, and the cost outcome only.
vc <- raw |>
  filter(is_africa(Country), Outcome == COST_OUTCOME) |>
  mutate(
    years = lapply(Measurement_Year, parse_years),
    n_years = lengths(years),
    year_first = vapply(years, function(y) if (length(y)) min(y) else NA_integer_, 1L),
    year_last = vapply(years, function(y) if (length(y)) max(y) else NA_integer_, 1L),
    unit = trimws(Outcome_Unit),
    value_trt = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Value_Trt)),
    value_con = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Value_Con)),
    practices = vapply(strsplit(cc4a_practices, "; "), function(p) {
      l <- PRACTICE_LABELS[p]; l[is.na(l)] <- p[is.na(l)]; paste(l, collapse = "; ")
    }, ""),
    items = items_by_row(pick(all_of(COST_ITEMS))),
    where = trimws(paste(coalesce(Site_Name, ""), coalesce(Product, ""), sep = ", "), whitespace = "[ ,]")
  )
n_africa_all <- raw |> filter(is_africa(Country)) |> distinct(StudyID) |> nrow()
```

## How many years do papers report variable costs for?

Of the `r n_africa_all` African studies in the extraction, **`r n_distinct(vc$StudyID)` report variable costs**. The chart counts them by the number of years their variable-cost data cover. A paper can cover several years in two ways: a **separate value for each year**, which shows how costs change, or **one value pooled over the years**, which does not.

```{r years-bar}
papers <- vc |>
  group_by(StudyID) |>
  summarise(
    Title = first(Title), Country = first(Country),
    practices = paste(sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(practices, "; ")))), collapse = "; "),
    unit = paste(sort(unique(unit)), collapse = ", "),
    years_covered = length(unique(unlist(years))),
    separate_years = n_distinct(year_first[n_years == 1]),
    first_year = suppressWarnings(min(year_first, na.rm = TRUE)),
    last_year = suppressWarnings(max(year_last, na.rm = TRUE)),
    arms = n_distinct(Treatment_Name),
    items = items_text(pick(all_of(COST_ITEMS))),
    DOI = first(DOI),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    years_covered = ifelse(years_covered == 0, NA, years_covered),
    how = case_when(is.na(years_covered) ~ "No year recorded",
                    years_covered == 1 ~ "One year",
                    separate_years >= 2 & separate_years == years_covered ~ "A separate value for each year",
                    separate_years >= 2 ~ "Separate values for some years",
                    TRUE ~ "One value pooled over the years"),
    period = ifelse(first_year == last_year, as.character(first_year),
                    paste(first_year, last_year, sep = " to ")),
    paper = paste0("[", ifelse(is.na(years_covered), "?", years_covered), " yr] ", Country, ": ",
                   substr(Title, 1, 70), ifelse(nchar(Title) > 70, "...", ""), " (", unit, ")")
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(years_covered), Country)

bars <- papers |> filter(!is.na(years_covered)) |> count(years_covered, how)
how_cols <- c("A separate value for each year" = COL_PRACTICE,
              "Separate values for some years" = "#6baed6",
              "One value pooled over the years" = "#fdae61",
              "One year" = "#bdbdbd")
plot_ly(bars, x = ~years_covered, y = ~n, color = ~how, colors = how_cols, type = "bar",
        text = ~paste0(n, " paper(s): ", years_covered, " year(s), ", tolower(how)),
        hoverinfo = "text", textposition = "none", height = 380) |>
  layout(barmode = "stack",
         xaxis = list(title = "Years of variable-cost data in the paper", dtick = 1,
                      range = c(0.4, max(bars$years_covered) + 0.6)),
         yaxis = list(title = "Papers", dtick = 1),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.3))
```

## Find papers by number of years

Tick the numbers of years you want (for example **5**). The table keeps only those papers and lists, for each, the years, the practice, the currency and which cost items its variable costs include. Use the paper's name in the next section to plot it.

```{r find-papers}
sd_papers <- SharedData$new(
  papers |> transmute(years_covered, period, how, Country,
                      title = paste0(substr(Title, 1, 90), ifelse(nchar(Title) > 90, "...", "")),
                      practices, unit, items),
  group = "papers"
)
htmltools::tagList(
  filter_checkbox("p_years", "Years of variable-cost data", sd_papers, ~years_covered,
                  inline = TRUE),
  datatable(sd_papers, rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe hover", width = "100%",
            colnames = c("Years", "Period", "How the years are reported", "Country", "Paper",
                         "Practice", "Unit", "Cost items included"),
            options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "tip", autoWidth = FALSE,
                           columnDefs = list(list(width = "40px", targets = 0),
                                             list(width = "90px", targets = c(1, 3, 6)),
                                             list(width = "120px", targets = 2),
                                             list(width = "260px", targets = 4))))
)
```

## Plot a paper's variable costs

Pick a paper. The chart shows its variable cost for each treatment arm over the years it reports: **solid blue lines are treatment arms, grey dashed lines are control arms**. (The 2022 extraction records each comparison as a treatment and control pair; an arm used in both roles is drawn once, as a treatment arm.) Hover over a point for the arm, the value, the year as recorded and the cost items included. Values are in the paper's own currency; a value pooled over several years is drawn as a flat line across them.

```{r plot-paper}
# Each extracted row pairs a treatment arm with a control arm. Both become
# points; an arm compared with several controls, or a control shared by
# several arms, is kept once, and an arm used in both roles in one paper is
# kept as a treatment arm.
make_points <- function(d, role, arm, value) {
  d |>
    filter(!is.na({{ value }})) |>
    transmute(StudyID, unit, where, items, Measurement_Year, n_years, year_first, year_last,
              arm = {{ arm }}, role = role, value = {{ value }})
}
trt_pts <- make_points(vc, "Treatment", Treatment_Name, value_trt)
con_pts <- make_points(vc, "Control", Control_Name, value_con) |>
  anti_join(distinct(trt_pts, StudyID, arm), by = c("StudyID", "arm"))
pts <- bind_rows(trt_pts, con_pts) |>
  distinct(StudyID, unit, where, Measurement_Year, arm, role, value, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(!is.na(year_first))

# Single-year values sit on their year (seasons spread within it). A value
# pooled over several years becomes two points, at its first and last year.
single <- pts |> filter(n_years == 1) |> mutate(x = time_point(Measurement_Year, year_first))
pooled <- pts |> filter(n_years > 1)
pooled <- bind_rows(mutate(pooled, x = year_first), mutate(pooled, x = year_last))
plot_pts <- bind_rows(single, pooled) |>
  left_join(select(papers, StudyID, paper), by = "StudyID") |>
  mutate(arm_where = ifelse(nzchar(where), paste0(arm, " (", where, ")"), arm),
         line = paste(role, arm_where, if_else(n_years > 1, Measurement_Year, ""), sep = " :: "),
         hover = paste0("<b>", arm_where, "</b> (", tolower(role), " arm)<br>",
                        format(value, big.mark = ","), " ", unit,
                        "<br>Year as recorded: ", Measurement_Year,
                        ifelse(n_years > 1, " (one value for these years)", ""),
                        "<br>", items)) |>
  arrange(paper, line, x) |>
  select(arm_where, role, Measurement_Year, value, unit, items, everything())

sd_pts <- SharedData$new(plot_pts, key = ~paste(line, x, value), group = "points")
default_paper <- papers$paper[papers$how == "A separate value for each year"][1]
if (is.na(default_paper)) default_paper <- papers$paper[1]

htmltools::tagList(
  filter_select("vc_paper", "Paper", sd_pts, ~paper, multiple = FALSE),
  plot_ly(sd_pts, x = ~x, y = ~value, split = ~line, color = ~role,
          colors = c(Treatment = COL_PRACTICE, Control = COL_CONTROL),
          linetype = ~role, linetypes = c(Treatment = "solid", Control = "dash"),
          type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text",
          showlegend = FALSE, height = 450) |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = "Year", dtick = 1),
           yaxis = list(title = "Variable cost (paper's own currency and unit)", rangemode = "tozero"),
           margin = list(t = 20)),
  datatable(sd_pts, rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe hover", width = "100%",
            options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "tip",
                           columnDefs = list(list(visible = FALSE,
                                                  targets = which(!names(plot_pts) %in% c(
                                                    "arm_where", "role", "Measurement_Year",
                                                    "value", "unit", "items")) - 1))),
            colnames = setNames(c("arm_where", "role", "Measurement_Year", "value", "unit", "items"),
                                c("Arm", "Role", "Year as recorded", "Variable cost", "Unit",
                                  "Cost items included")))
)
```

```{r default-paper, results = "asis"}
# crosstalk has no default selection, so the page picks one paper on load:
# otherwise every paper, in every currency, is drawn at once.
cat(sprintf('<script>
window.addEventListener("load", function () {
  var tries = 0;
  (function pick() {
    var el = document.querySelector("#vc_paper select");
    if (el && el.selectize) { el.selectize.setValue(%s); return; }
    if (tries++ < 50) setTimeout(pick, 100);
  })();
});
</script>', jsonlite::toJSON(default_paper, auto_unbox = TRUE)))
```

## All variable-cost rows

Every African variable-cost observation, for checking or download.

```{r explorer}
datatable(vc |>
            transmute(StudyID, Title, Country, Practices = practices, Site = Site_Name, Product,
                      Treatment = Treatment_Name, Control = Control_Name, Unit = unit,
                      `Value (practice)` = value_trt, `Value (control)` = value_con,
                      `Year as recorded` = Measurement_Year, `Years covered` = n_years,
                      `Cost items` = items, Location = Value_Loc, DOI, Extractor = extractor),
          rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", extensions = "Buttons",
          options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "Bfrtip",
                         buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")))
```
